tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: Except as provided in subsection (b), the coastwise laws apply to the United States, including the island territories and possessions of the United States.

tree.heading: Exceptions.—
tree.text: The coastwise laws do not apply to—

children.text: the Northern Mariana Islands, except as provided in section 502(b) of the Covenant To Establish a Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands in Political Union With the United States of America (48 U.S.C. 1801 note); or
the Virgin Islands until the President declares by proclamation that the coastwise laws apply to the Virgin Islands.

(b)(2), is contained in section 1 of Pub. L. 94–241, set out as a note under section 1801 of Title 48, Territories and Insular Possessions.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2008—Subsec. (b). Pub. L. 110–181 inserted “or” after semicolon at end of par. (2), redesignated par. (4) as (3), and struck out former par. (3) which read as follows: “Canton Island until the President declares by proclamation that the coastwise laws apply to Canton Island; or”.
